description: Issue #839 (maintainer ruling #833 rule 3, "nothing shadows"): `define forward … print 1 … end` then `print fd`. The runtime phase-1 registration guard (`spec/execution-model.md:82-89`) raises `ol-reserved-word` (`spec/error-model.md:125`) at the declaration, so the procedure never runs and the event stream is empty. Since issue #815 the check also sees the `print fd` on the last line and reports its own faults there, so the empty event stream — not the absence of a reporter-position finding — is what evidences the halt. Re-legalising `define forward` reddens this and leads the next reader to #787. The evaluator-level invariant is carried in `packages/runtime/src/heritage-alias-chokepoint.test.mjs`. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy does not appear beside the check's. The other findings recorded here are independent faults in the same program, each reported once.
